cohort_rule: Next ten distinct non-experiment PRs with Go changes and head commits first observed after registration; one snapshot per PR, ordered by first observation. Existing unchanged heads listed below excluded. Pin merge base and head before inference or reference review. Audit exact rendered diff overlap; report overlapping cases separately, never silently replace them.
evaluation: Blinded authorization-relevance review plus isolated paired full/candidate evidence reviews; source-adjudicate findings. Report input tokens including cache reads/writes, output tokens, latency, cost and cache confounding. Packet reductions alone are not savings.
execution_status: Registered protocol only; no persistent polling service installed.
promotion: No automatic promotion. Require prospective relevance and finding retention plus material measured cost reduction; 95% point relevance target is provisional, not authorization to omit source.
stop_rule: Ten eligible snapshots or explicit user stop. No retraining or threshold change within cohort. Missing/oversized evidence retains full review.
